answer: At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a terrace tag. The voyage cap is enforced at intake and grove exposes the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a swarm in one epoch however much capital it holds, as each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The deposit is 5 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
